# r300ya

**English** | [Русский](README.ru.md)

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/KobzevAY/r300ya/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/KobzevAY/r300ya/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

**r300ya** is an R interface to the Yandex service <https://300.ya.ru>. The service uses the YandexGPT neural network to retell a web page: it returns the title and a list of the main theses.

## Installation

Install the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/KobzevAY/r300ya):

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("KobzevAY/r300ya")
```

## Getting a token

Any user signed in to Yandex can get a token on 300.ya.ru as shown below:

![How to get a token on 300.ya.ru](man/figures/r300ya_token.png)

Rather than writing the token in your scripts, store it in your `.Renviron` file (open it with `usethis::edit_r_environ()`):

```
YA300_TOKEN=your_token
```

After restarting R the package picks the token up automatically.

## Example

The main function, `retell_text()`, takes two arguments:

- `url`: the link to the original page;
- `token`: your token (by default taken from the `YA300_TOKEN` environment variable).

```{r example, eval = FALSE}
library(r300ya)

res <- retell_text("https://habr.com/ru/news/729422/")
res
#> «Яндекс Браузер» научили переводить с китайского языка и автоматически накладывать русскую озвучку
#> * Яндекс Браузер научился переводить видео с китайского языка
#> * Технология работает на YouTube и будет добавлена на Bilibili
#> * Разработчики создали датасет из 1,5 млн видео с субтитрами на севернокитайском языке
#> * ...
#>
#> Retelling: https://300.ya.ru/3fOcYRBL
#> Original:  https://habr.com/ru/news/729422/
```

The result is a list with elements:

- `title`: the article title;
- `short_text`: the theses of the short retelling (a character vector);
- `theses`: the detailed retelling, a data frame with columns `chapter` and `thesis`;
- `short_url`: the link to the retelling on 300.ya.ru;
- `original_url`: the original link.

The original page can be in any language; YandexGPT will try to retell it. Retellings are produced in Russian.

See `vignette("r300ya")` for a longer walkthrough.

## Limitations and errors

The service cannot retell a page if:

- the page is too long;
- the link points to a file (e.g. `*.pdf`) rather than an article;
- the page has too little text.

In these cases, and when the token is wrong, `retell_text()` throws an error. Each error has a class, so you can handle them:

- `r300ya_error_token`: the token is missing or rejected;
- `r300ya_error_api`: the service could not retell the page (the message includes the reason);
- `r300ya_error_parse`: the retelling page could not be parsed (most likely 300.ya.ru changed its layout; please report it in the [issues](https://github.com/KobzevAY/r300ya/issues));
- `r300ya_error_input`: `url` is invalid.

For example, to retell several pages and skip the ones that fail:

```{r batch, eval = FALSE}
urls <- c("https://habr.com/ru/news/729422/", "https://example.com/file.pdf")

results <- lapply(urls, function(u) {
  tryCatch(retell_text(u), r300ya_error_api = function(e) NULL)
})
```

## Terms of use

The package only automates requests you could make yourself on <https://300.ya.ru>. By using it you agree to the [300.ya.ru terms of use](https://yandex.ru/legal/300ya_termsofuse/).
